author.name: ChatGPT for Writing Teachers: A Primer – Preterition

message: […] I find the generative capacity of those spaces to be as exciting than anything I’ve seen in my 20+ years of teaching college writing. As I mentioned at the beginning, I experimented with the proto-chatbot Eliza as an undergraduate in the 1980s, and took great delight in getting the computer to write filthy things about piglets. I’ll close here by sharing again sharing the delightful close of ChatGPT’s dramatic monologue from a few days ago. […]
